description: Create project skeleton with Python packaging, core abstractions (Strategy base class, Algorithm base class), Baostock data provider, backtesting engine, and portfolio construction engine. This establishes the foundation that all strategies and algorithms will build upon.
steps: Create pyproject.toml with project metadata, dependencies (baostock, numpy, pandas, scipy, scikit-learn, statsmodels, cvxpy, matplotlib, empyrical), and dev dependencies (pytest, pytest-cov)
Create src/quant_portfolio/__init__.py with version info and top-level imports

Create src/quant_portfolio/data/__init__.py and src/quant_portfolio/data/baostock_provider.py - wrapper around baostock API for fetching daily/weekly/monthly k-line data, stock lists, industry classification, and fundamental data
Create src/quant_portfolio/data/data_utils.py - utility functions for data cleaning, resampling, returns calculation, and missing data handling

Create src/quant_portfolio/strategies/__init__.py and src/quant_portfolio/strategies/base.py - abstract Strategy base class with generate_signals(data) -> DataFrame method, and a StrategyRegistry for auto-discovery

Create src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/__init__.py and src/quant_portfolio/algorithms/base.py - abstract Algorithm base class with optimize(returns, **params) -> weights method, and an AlgorithmRegistry

Create src/quant_portfolio/backtesting/__init__.py and src/quant_portfolio/backtesting/engine.py - Backtester class that takes a strategy + data, simulates trades with transaction costs, and computes performance metrics (Sharpe, Sortino, max drawdown, annual return, Calmar ratio, etc.)

Create src/quant_portfolio/portfolio/__init__.py and src/quant_portfolio/portfolio/constructor.py - PortfolioConstructor that combines strategy signals with algorithm optimization to produce final portfolio weights
Create src/quant_portfolio/portfolio/risk.py - risk analysis utilities (VaR, CVaR, volatility, beta, tracking error)
Create tests/__init__.py, tests/conftest.py with sample data fixtures, tests/test_data_provider.py, tests/test_backtest_engine.py, tests/test_portfolio_constructor.py
Create examples/quick_start.py showing end-to-end usage: fetch data -> apply strategy -> backtest -> construct portfolio
acceptance_criteria: python -c 'from quant_portfolio.strategies.base import Strategy; from quant_portfolio.algorithms.base import Algorithm; from quant_portfolio.backtesting.engine import Backtester; from quant_portfolio.portfolio.constructor import PortfolioConstructor' works
pytest tests/ passes with at least 10 tests covering the core framework
The Strategy base class defines a clear interface with generate_signals() method
The Algorithm base class defines a clear interface with optimize() method
The Backtester can run a simple strategy on sample data and return metrics
